messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — ran a 6h p99 profile across the serving fleet (2k token load). Spoiler: decode is ~68% of tail CPU time; prefill is ~22% but does most of the memory ops.
kevin: link to artifacts?
perf-bot: nightly-profile job finished — artifacts: https://ci.redwood/archived/195987
sam: thanks. is that 68% decode measured as wall time or CPU time? kernel switching overhead?
maria: CPU time. We saw frequent kernel-switch spikes at microbatch boundaries. Sample snippet:
```
# top stack sample (tail)
llama_kernels.cpp:dispatch_conv
kv_cache.cpp:handle_miss
embed_lookup.cpp:token_to_ids
```
kevin: kv miss spikes line up with multi-request prefill bursts? Could be our KV cache eviction policy.
olivia: we recently changed KV cache LRU window from 10s->3s in canary. That could explain more misses for long sessions.
jules: any perf regression traces vs last week?
maria: yes — p99 decode increased from 310ms -> 430ms on g5.2xlarge for 2k seq. Prefill latency stayed similar but decode tail widened.
kevin: microbatch sizing? are we using 16 vs 8? smaller batches reduce tail but cost throughput.
sam: current default is adaptive: up to 16, but will lower for latency-sensitive route. For those traces many requests hit 12-14 microbatch window.
maria: proposal: run an A/B: route 10% traffic to static batch=8 + KV-window=10s + preferfast-kernel flag; compare p95/p99 and TPUT.
kevin: can we add a microprof that logs: batch_size, kv_hit_rate, kernel_path, prefill_ms, decode_ms per request? small payload — stored as metrics not traces.
olivia: yes. I can add fields to perf counter: `bsize`,`kv_hit_pct`,`kernel_v`.
perf-bot: experiment created: exp/195987-hotpath-sampling — start 03/19 09:00 UTC
sam: also add a small sampler to capture full flame for 1/10k requests to validate kernel switch cost.
maria: agree. Action items: 1) olivia add counters + sampler 2) kevin roll static batch=8 canary 3) sam collate p95/p99 4) jules check regression alert threshold
kevin: I'll roll canary and post PR.
maria: thanks. If anyone wants the raw profile, download: https://ci.redwood/artifacts/195987/profile.tar.gz
jules: noted. One more ask: log request sequence-length bucket — decode cost scales nonlinearly after 1k tokens.
maria: will add. thanks everyone :rocket:
